we propose and implement a solution to the access control problem for inter-organizable workflow that is based on the concept of a workflow security service, that we propose and develop a security policy language for inter-organisational workflow, that we propose a workflow security service architecture, that we develop an access control model for inter-organiztional workflow that supports fine-grained access controls and that our implementation of the access control solution is based on a workflow security service.

the security requirements of an inter-organizational system are different from those of an intranet system and the access control mechanisms for interorganizational workflow must be designed to address the security requirements.

the security requirements for inter-organization workflow, and the design and implementation of an access control solution for inter-organization work flow.
the access control mechanisms for interorganizational workflow and the design of a secure inter-organizational collaboration infrastructure.
providing a flexible and scalable access control mechanism that supports fine-grained access rights to inter-organizational workflows.

the access control requirements and solutions in our paper are important and useful for the design and implementation of future inter-organizational workflows.
we have developed an inter-organizational access control framework for inter-organizatonal collaborative computing, especially for inter-organzational workflow.
we have presented an approach to access control for interorganizational workflow, which addresses many of the problems in existing solutions, and which is scalable, flexible, and fine-grained.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the inter-organizational access control model is based on the organization level access control model, which provides fine-grained control for workflow objects, and that it is scalable and independent from the concrete organization level security policy.
we have developed a security infrastructure that provides access control solutions for workflow management in a distributed environment.

we have proposed and implemented an inter-organizational access control mechanism that is based on a security model and that can be used to provide fine-grained access controls for inter-organizations workflow.

access control requirements for workflow security can be met by the combination of existing access control technologies and workflow technologies.
we can provide a scalable and secure inter-organizational access control framework by separating inter-organizational security from concrete organization-level enforcement.
